name: Update memory item
description: Replace the text of memory item number n (as shown by memory_recall). The item keeps its position and original timestamp. Use when a remembered fact changes.

n.description: 1-based item number to update (as shown in the numbered list).

text.description: The new text for that item.

path.description: Workspace path of the memory list (default 'w/memory').

updated.description: True if the item was updated.
